title: Munich Motor Imagery dataset
description: The Munich Motor Imagery dataset comprises electroencephalographic recordings from 10 healthy subjects performing two-class motor imagery tasks (left and right hand) cued by visual arrow stimuli. The dataset includes 128-channel EEG data sampled at 500 Hz with preprocessed signals suitable for brain-computer interface research and benchmarking of spatial filtering and classification methods.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 128-channel BrainAmp system at 500 Hz sampling rate with reference at Cz and standard 10-20 montage. Subjects performed motor imagery tasks during 7-second cue periods indicated by directional arrows. Data were preprocessed with common average reference re-referencing and no artifact rejection applied.
